projectDescription: A full-stack LeetCode prep and progress tracker with spaced repetition, sprint-based study plans, mock interviews, analytics, and cross-device sync.
keyFeatures: Spaced repetition scheduling for LeetCode problems
Sprint-based structured study with category focus
Daily plan generation with time estimates
Mock interview mode with in-app code editor
Progress analytics with mastery trends and charts
LeetCode username sync for submission history
Streak tracking with grace day support
Cross-device sync via Supabase + Clerk auth
Catch-up plan when study days are missed
Cold solve challenges for retention testing
publicApiSurface: useProblemProgress() — log, review, and query problem progress
useUserSettings() — read and update study settings
useSprintState() — manage sprint categories and history
useSessionTimings() — track solve times per category
useStreak() — current and max streak state
ProblemProgress — per-problem SR state and history
SprintState — active sprint category and status
